resources.string: Manage people sharing deck completions with you

All deck completion notifications are paused. Your choices below are kept.

People sharing decks with you and people you unsubscribed from appear here. Only you can resubscribe after turning someone off. These choices apply across your devices; resubscribing allows future completions. Streak reminders, messages and replies are unaffected.
Set your AnkiQuest server, player name and token in AnkiQuest settings to manage notifications.
Your server could not verify this player and token. Check them in AnkiQuest settings, then try again.
This server does not support incoming notification settings yet. Update the AnkiQuest server, then try again.
Could not confirm your notification choices. Check your connection and try again before making another change.
Nobody is sharing deck completions with you yet, and you have no saved unsubscribes. You can still turn all deck completion notifications on or off.
People you muted before are shown as unsubscribed. Saving any change here, including the switch above, also removes you from their sharing lists.
